description: Scrape the list of pages on a website. 1 credit per call. Input: url, search, sitemap, includeSubdomains, ignoreQuery...

ignoreCache.description: Send true to build the list again instead of reusing one made in the last 6 hours.

ignoreQueryParameters.description: List each page once, without its ?query part.

includeSubdomains.description: Also list pages on subdomains, such as docs.bun.com for bun.com.

limit.description: The most addresses to return, up to 100000.

location.description: Where to read the page from. The default is the United States.

country.description: Two-letter country code to read the page from, such as DE or JP.

languages.description: Languages to ask the site for, best first, such as ["de", "en"]. Sent as Accept-Language. A read with languages is never answered from or saved to a stored copy.

search.description: Keep only addresses that mention these words, best matches first, such as pricing.

sitemap.description: include uses the site's sitemaps and its pages. only lists just what the sitemaps name. skip ignores the sitemaps.

timeout.description: Stop looking after this many milliseconds and return what was found.

url.description: Any page of the site to map, such as https://bun.com.

name: stophy_map
title: Web Map
